Posted February 10, 2006
Analysis by Richard Cowan

It has been a very strange week. Not that I am unaccustomed to that sort of thing.  

Steve Kubby has a new lawyer, J. David Nick, a veteran of many medical marijuana cases in California.
See
California Medical Marijuana Activist Wins Right to Grow Medicine For Others

The change in attorneys is a result of disagreements on strategy with Bill McPike, which may or may not be justified, but changing lawyers can sometimes be a good move when dealing with prosecutors as incompetent as those in Placer County.

Let him eat Marinol

In addition to their regular website Kubby.com www.kubby.com, the Kubbys have also launched a jailhouse blog http://blog.myspace.com/letfreedomgrow. They are forced to plead for funds for Marinol, the only form of cannabis that the Placer jail will allow, if the prisoner can afford to pay for it. Remember that the Canadian Immigration and Refugee (pause for laughter) apparatchiks claimed that prisoners in American jails receive excellent health care.  

It is also ironic that Kubby is in jail for the possession of minute quantities of two psychedelics that the police extracted from plant material, but is now forced to take a synthetic THC, and not allowed to take the plant on which it is based. But irony is simply laundry term in Placer County.
See
 Moving to The Next Step In Placer Justice: House-Arrest for the Homeless; Expensive Medicine for the Impoverished. Kubby and Marinol.
and
 The Surreal Stupidity Of Placer County. Kubby to Be Held Without Bail Until At Least Friday. Next Hearing At 8:30AM On February 3rd. No Doctor In Four Days. Shame On Canada! Shame On America!
and
 Steve Kubby Is the Only One In This Story Who Has NOT Broken The Law, But He Faces the Death Penalty.

Of course, the fact that Marinol is effective at all does not prove that it is as good as whole cannabis, which has controlled Kubby's cancer for decades, but it does prove that cannabis does actually have a medical benefit for persons with his type of cancer. The silence of the quacks 

From http://blog.myspace.com/letfreedomgrow:

"Placer County has forced Steve into a hypertensive episode to prove him incorrect about the medical value of cannabis in his life.  They have ridiculed him, mocked him, and forced him to live a demeaning life for the last few weeks.  All because the Law Enforcement, Judicial, Medical, and City Officials did not want to admit that marijuana has ample medical efficacy for many different ailments.

As you all know Steve has lost weight while being incarcerated, he has not been able to follow his very strict health diet, nor take any of his life saving medicine.  Steve was finally given Marinol as a joke by the medical staff.  The staff knew it was a farce and that medical marijuana really did not exist and that traditional medicines can work for Steve and they tried to prove it with this inhumane experiment at the risk of this man.

Well, all of a sudden the tables have turned!

Yes!  The Placer County Law Enforcement at the jail is standing utterly amazed!  Since the first dose of Marinol, Steve has been experiencing small amounts relief from the benefits of the one cannabinoid in Marinol - THC.  The very same people that were mocking and ridiculing Steve and telling him he needed to fess up to the truth and tell everyone that medical marijuana was a farce are calling him "Mr. Kubby."  They are beginning to see the error of their ways because Steve has now proven the exact opposite!  The Jail has even tried to make his special Tofu Salad diet for him.

Cannabis is Medicine!

Placer County set out to prove Fraud and got the truth instead.  Justice is closer [than it ever has been] at this moment.

The medical staff (Dr.'s and Nurses) are telling Steve that they had no idea about the medical efficacy of marijuana and that it could actually help the way it has for him.  They are all telling him that he should not be in jail, but rather, out being studied so marijuana cannabinoids can be studied to find out whey they have been working so well for him.

This is very exciting news and if any of you would like to give Michele a call an give her your sentiments, then call her on her cell phone @ 250-318-7118.

Thanks everyone and keep up all the support!"

Overgrow.com Overthrown

What would happen if a major website was shut down by the police and no one heard about it?  

Last week, Overgrow.com and related sites went offline and I kept waiting to see what would be reported. After all, this was a huge community of marijuana growers, perhaps hundreds of thousands over the years. However, even most marijuana users never heard of it, unless they were growing. It was certainly a useful forum for growers, but it was also a commercial operation that tolerated some of the slimiest people in the business.

Incredibly, the only reports on the seizing of the servers have been a few marijuana related sites. This raid should be of concern to the entire Internet community, but the absence of any hard news has undoubtedly inhibited possible protests from First Amendment advocates.

It seems that the Canadian and DEAland police seized the servers, which were in Canada, and arrested the owner who goes by the pseudonym Richard Calrisian. He was soon released and has 'disappeared.'

It was also reported that the police had arrested members of his family as hostages, and 'Calrisian' gave the police all of the passwords as 'ransom.'

Access to the servers could theoretically allow the police to trace the locations of growers, but it remains to be seen. One might think that the talent necessary for that would be better used going after terrorists, but given the priorities of the Bush Administration

As I warned after the DEA/RCMP went after a Vancouver based seed merchant, it was foolish to trust any Canadian sources.
See
DEA Tries To Scam Emery Customers Into Admitting That They Were Buying Seeds.

The Dutch and other European countries are now finding themselves stuck with some very unsavory characters, and this will bring undesirable heat to long-established Dutch growers.

As I have noted before, prohibitionism is a form of fascism. "As Conservative columnist George Will observesd, '(T)he Cold War may come to be remembered as a parenthesis in a much longer war against the remarkable resilience and insufficiently understood variousness of fascism.' Ironically, Will proves his own point because he does not seem to sufficiently understand that prohibitionism is a variation of fascism."
From
 We Have Already Won A Lot From The Supreme Court Case, Which Is Good Because That Is Probably All That We Are Going To Get. DEA Changes The Rules on Treating Pain.

If any proof is needed, consider the origins of a new drugs law in Italy.

As the Guardian reported, With the aroma of defiantly smoked cannabis floating in the air outside, lawmakers approved a measure that abolishes the distinction between hard and soft drugs and makes possession, as well as dealing, a criminal offence.

Typically, Silvio Berlusconi, the ethically challenged Prime Minister tied the bill to legislation for security measures at the Turin Winter Olympics. Just like Bush, Berluconi is using the fight against terrorists as a way to attack cannabis users.
See
 Media Covers War On Bongs More Than War On Patients. Questions About Ashcrofts Latest Jihad. Sites Redirected To DEA? High Times Magazine To Suffer Major Revenue Loss. Glass Makers Hardest Hit.

Italy's marijuana drugs laws were eased after a referendum in 1993, and have oscillated between repression and reform over the years.
See
Belgium and Italy Move To Decriminalize Cannabis, Moving Further Toward Dutch Policy

Typically, this latest reversal is being pushed by Gianfranco Fini, the deputy Prime Minister and the leader of the "formerly" neo-fascist National Alliance. The fascist origin of the new laws is illustrated in Fini's statement that cannabis use is a "rejection of the most elementary duties of the individual towards the various communities in which he or she lives". 

It is also interesting to note that he cites the 'potent marijuana' line, which is particularly absurd in Italy. He is quoted as saying, "The joint of 10 years ago had an active ingredient of at most 1.5%. Today, you can find them with as much as 15%". As in all of Europe, with the partial exception of The Netherlands, most of the cannabis ten years ago was hashish.
See
 European Study Shows Potency of Prohibitionist Propaganda. CBS and The AP Lie to the American People About the Dutch. Surprise!

Given the unpopularity of the scandal-ridden Berlusconi government, this new law won't last long. In the meantime, avoid Italy. Tourists with a joint may find their passports impounded.

Speaking of governments that probably won't last very long, there is new Conservative minority government in Canada. The new Justice Minister is Vic Toews, former attorney general for Manitoba, and an ardent prohibitionist.

The good news is that the phony decrim bill sort of supported by the former Liberal government is dead, and it is unlikely that any really bad marijuana laws could make it through the divided House, much less the Senate.
See
 Faux Canada! Phony Decrim Bill Dead Until Next Parliament. Phony Medical Cannabis Program Still Ignores Courts. Collaboration With DEA Puts American Medical Users in Danger, But No Asylum.
and
 RCMP Report On The Drug Situation in Canada  2004 Contradicts The Prohibitionist Party Line  Again. Mexico Supplies US With At Least 25 Times More Than Canada. Ontario Rivals British Columbia .

The bad news is that Toews is likely to poison the public discourse, just like the fascists in Italy. The son of Mennonite missionaries, Toews should know better, but he is a strong advocate of state violence against peaceful cannabis users. Like most prohibitionists, he believes whatever supports his prejudices and violates the Commandment against giving false evidence. For example, he is quoted as asking the rhetorical question, 'Why then in Lower Mainland B.C. do we have 8,000 to 10,000 grow ops and meth and other labs and across the border in the U.S.  there are virtually none?'

That is patently absurd and is based on the RCMP/prohibitionist party line.
See
 Voice of America Becomes Latest Organization to Be Corrupted By Cannabis Prohibition. Canadian Collaborators Lie To Undermine Their Countrys Freedom and Sovereignty. The Myth of BC Bud.
and
 The Prohibitionist Counterattack In Canada Runs Into Some Flack. RCMP Challenged. And I Have Fun Writing A Letter to the Editor.

One last item. NORML has an excellent new report on cannabis and mental health.
See
Cannabis, Mental Health and Context: The Case For Regulation
